subject: Post-demo: ingestion cadence, evaluation rubric & deliverable commitments
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clarosys.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clarosys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: ingestion cadence, evaluation rubric & deliverable commitments

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great discussion and helpful context on the two evaluation streams you want to run (support-response rewriting and internal knowledge retrieval). This note captures the commitments we made and the minimal artifacts we need from Clarosys to get the POC ingestion pipeline and evaluation harness going.

Quick summary of success criteria we agreed on:
- Retrieval: achieve top-1 retrieval accuracy >= 78% on the internal KB slice (measured on your holdout queries).
- Generation: response re-write quality (human eval) at par or improved vs current baseline for the 500-sample test set.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation < 450ms for the build prompts in demo conditions.

Deliverables Clarosys to provide (we discussed):
1) 1k sample prompts/logs (JSONL) representing the two workloads (support replies + knowledge queries). Include a field indicating "workload_type" for each entry.
2) A 200–500 item holdout set (separate file) for final scoring.
3) Any PII/anonymization requirements and a short doc on acceptable redaction rules.
4) Contact and storage preference (S3 upload + temp credentials, or a secured Drive folder).

I've attached a prompt_manifest_template.csv to make the metadata mapping explicit (required fields: id, text, workload_type, user_metadata, timestamp). Also attaching a short security_requirements_summary for reference on upload options.

Proposed ingestion cadence (again, flexible):
- T+0 (this week): Clarosys uploads 200 sample prompts and the holdout set (minimum).
- T+3 business days: Redwood runs an initial ingest + smoke evaluation and returns a short data quality report.
- T+10 business days: First model iteration results + qualitative sample review; next-file transfer for remainder of items.

Ownership and next steps (recommended):
- Clarosys data lead: Samantha Lee (we'll coordinate ingestion with her).
- Redwood SE for ingest: Karthik Iyer (will provide S3/format instructions).
- Trial owner (commercial): Ben Carter (who will track timelines and success criteria).

Can you confirm the T+0 upload window and whether S3 is acceptable? If S3 is not possible, we can provide a secure Drive folder link.

Thanks — I can hop on a short sync if you want to walk through the manifest.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: prompt_manifest_template.csv, security_requirements_summary.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clarosys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clarosys.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ingestion cadence, evaluation rubric & deliverable commitments

Thanks Hannah — and appreciated the clear checklist. Confirming Clarosys will provide an initial batch this week. A few notes:

- We'll upload ~250 mixed prompts (support + retrieval) by end of day Friday (2026-11-13). We'll also include a 250-item holdout set.
- We have internal PII redaction rules; attaching the internal policy now (pii_redaction_policy.pdf). We will sanitize user identifiers but will leave salient domain-specific tokens intact per the policy.
- Preferred upload: S3. Tom will provision a short-lived bucket and share creds; if you prefer, we can also place the files in the Drive folder you shared.

One question: for the rewrite evaluation, do you need original agent_response + suggested_response fields for each prompt, or is original text + expected quality label sufficient? We can provide both but want to know the minimal acceptable schema to speed delivery.

Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Customer Experience | Clarosys
samantha.lee@clarosys.com

Attachments: clarosys_sample_prompts.jsonl, pii_redaction_policy.pdf

On Nov 7, 2026, at 3:05 PM, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> (quoted earlier message)

To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clarosys.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clarosys.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ingestion cadence, evaluation rubric & deliverable commitments

Hi Sam / Tom —

Thanks for the sample file and the redaction doc — that helps. Quick clarifications on the minimal schema we need for automated ingest (to avoid back-and-forth):
- Required JSONL fields per record: id, text, workload_type, timestamp, original_response (optional), expected_response (optional), user_metadata (optional).
- For rewrite evaluation we prefer both original_response + expected_response when available. If you only have original_response + label, we can still run the quality buckets but it reduces supervised signal.
- File size: up to 100MB per file is fine; you can split into multiple JSONL shards (we ask for clear naming: clarosys_prompts_part-01.jsonl, part-02.jsonl).

Upload instructions (S3 preferred):
1) Create an S3 bucket or folder and share a short-lived IAM role or pre-signed PUTs with kyle-ingest@redwood.com (we will only use the creds to pull the files).
2) If you prefer Drive, drop files in the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefExampleUploadFolder and share edit access to kyle-ingest@redwood.com.

I've added a short intake checklist into the HubSpot deal so we can mark items as received: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4382

Karthik — can you take point on the S3 manifest parsing and let Sam know if there are any non-standard fields Clarosys should keep?

Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: ingestion cadence, evaluation rubric & deliverable commitments

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sam. Confirming the agreed items and next steps so we all have the same plan:

Agreed commitments and owners:
- Clarosys (Samantha): upload first 250 prompts + 250 holdout by 2026-11-13 EOD to S3. Files should be named clarosys_prompts_part-01.jsonl and clarosys_holdout_v1.jsonl.
- Redwood SE (Karthik): provide a manifest validator script and sample S3 presigned request template by 2026-11-10.
- Redwood (Ben): run initial smoke evaluation and share data-quality report by 2026-11-16.
- Success criteria: retrieval >=78% top-1 on holdout; rewrite quality improvement measured on sampled human eval (protocol attached to this thread).

If S3 creds come through, Karthik will schedule an ingest window on Monday. If anything slips, please flag by EOD Friday so we can adjust timeline.

I'd like to schedule a 20-minute sync after the initial smoke run (week of 11/16) to review results and prioritize the second batch. Ben — I'll let you propose a calendar invite.

Thanks all — excited to get started.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
